messages.name: Booking accepted
messages.body:
Hi {{guestFirstName}},
We are happy to tell you that your booking for {{houseName}} is now confirmed. We look forward to your visit to Brooklyn. Your booking details are below.
If you have any questions, please call or text {{housePhone}} or reply to this email.
Until we meet, travel safe!
{{ownerName}}

messages.name: Balance due reminder
messages.body:
Hi {{guestFirstName}},
Your remaining balance for {{houseName}} is due today. Please use the secure payment link below when you are ready.
{{balancePaymentLink}}
Thank you.

messages.name: Check-in instructions
messages.body:
Your apartment is located under the stoop, on your left as you walk in the gate.
Access is via a numeric keypad lock.
The code for your stay is set to the last four digits of your phone number.

messages.name: Welcome message
messages.body: Hi {{guestFirstName}}, welcome to {{houseName}}. I hope you had a smooth arrival and are settling in comfortably. I have put together a local guide with favorite spots to eat, explore, and relax. If there is anything you need during your stay, reply here or call {{housePhone}}.

messages.name: Check-out reminder
messages.body:
Check-out time is 11 am.
Please leave the place tidy and put trash and recycling in the bins located outside.
No need to strip beds or gather towels.
Thanks!

messages.name: Review request
messages.body:
Hi {{guestFirstName}},
I hope your stay was a great one. Would you mind taking a minute to leave a review?
{{reviewLink}}
Thank you again for choosing {{houseName}}.
